basic.label: Basic
basic.description: A question and answer for general flashcards.

vocabulary-with-hints.label: Vocabulary with hints
vocabulary-with-hints.description: Learn words with a pronunciation hint, an optional image and a hint for related forms.

emoji-and-pills.label: Emoji and pills
emoji-and-pills.description: Use an emoji as a cue and show related words as pills on the answer.

symbols.label: Symbols and characters
symbols.description: Study kanji, letters or symbols in large type, with an optional reading beneath.

audio-stacked.label: Audio below the prompt
audio-stacked.description: Practise listening to sentences with the replay control below the prompt.

audio-inline.label: Audio beside the prompt
audio-inline.description: Practise listening to short words or phrases with the replay control next to the prompt.

image-only.label: Image-only prompt
image-only.description: Identify a plant, animal or object from a full-width image.

image-and-text.label: Image and text prompt
image-and-text.description: Associate a written prompt with an image shown above it.

grammar.label: Grammar and usage
grammar.description: Learn a grammar pattern from a sentence, usage notes and an optional translation hint.

multiple-choice.label: Multiple Choice
multiple-choice.description: Use two HTML lists to show the choices and mark incorrect answers on the back.

multiple-choice-2.label: Multiple Choice 2
multiple-choice-2.description: Choose answers interactively, then use Show Answer to see correct, incorrect and missed choices.
